Kafka Serializer<T> was not found. This mapper converts producer key/value type T to bytes.
    For JSON payloads, request the @Json serializer and make sure JsonWriter<T> exists for the payload type.
    For custom binary, protobuf, Avro, or domain-specific payloads, provide a Serializer<T> component or module method. Check @Tag(...) on the publisher key/value and serializer.

Kafka Serializer<T> with @Json was not found. Kora can create a JSON serializer when JsonWriter<T> exists for the payload type.
    Annotate the payload model with @Json or @JsonWriter, or provide a custom JsonWriter<T> component.
    Alternative: provide a custom @Json Serializer<T> component or module method if JSON generation is not desired.

Kafka Deserializer<T> was not found. This mapper converts consumer key/value bytes to type T.
    For JSON payloads, request the @Json deserializer and make sure JsonReader<T> exists for the payload type.
    For custom binary, protobuf, Avro, or domain-specific payloads, provide a Deserializer<T> component or module method. Check @Tag(...) on the listener key/value and deserializer.

Kafka Deserializer<T> with @Json was not found. Kora can create a JSON deserializer when JsonReader<T> exists for the payload type.
    Annotate the payload model with @Json or @JsonReader, or provide a custom JsonReader<T> component.
    Alternative: provide a custom @Json Deserializer<T> component or module method if JSON generation is not desired.
